SCContentFilter.doc: An instance that filters the content a stream captures.

SCContentSharingPicker.doc: An instance of a picker presented by the operating system for managing frame-capture streams.

SCContentSharingPickerConfiguration.doc: An instance for configuring the system content-sharing picker.

SCDisplay.doc: An instance that represents a display device.

SCRunningApplication.doc: An instance that represents an app running on a device.

SCScreenshotConfiguration.doc: An object that contains screenshot properties such as output width, height, and image quality specifications.

SCScreenshotManager.doc: An instance for the capture of single frames from a stream.

SCScreenshotOutput.doc: An object that contains all images requested by the client.

SCShareableContent.doc: An instance that represents a set of displays, apps, and windows that your app can capture.

SCShareableContentInfo.doc: An instance that provides information for the content in a given stream.

SCStream.doc: An instance that represents a stream of shareable content.

SCStreamConfiguration.doc: An instance that provides the output configuration for a stream.

SCWindow.doc: An instance that represents an onscreen window.

SCContentSharingPickerObserver.doc: An observer protocol your app implements to receive messages from the operating system’s content picker.

SCStreamDelegate.doc: A delegate protocol your app implements to respond to stream events.

SCStreamOutput.doc: A delegate protocol your app implements to receive capture stream output events.

SCCaptureDynamicRange.doc: Specifies whether the captured screen output is standard or high dynamic range.

SCCaptureDynamicRangeHDRCanonicalDisplay.doc: Specifies that the system captures the screen in high dynamic range with attributes of the canonical display.

SCCaptureDynamicRangeHDRLocalDisplay.doc: Specifies that the system captures the screen in high dynamic range with attributes of the local display.

SCCaptureDynamicRangeSDR.doc: Specifies that the system captures the screen in standard dynamic range.

SCCaptureResolutionAutomatic.doc: Allow ScreenCaptureKit to automatically select the quality of content depending on factors such as network connection.

SCCaptureResolutionBest.doc: Capture streaming content at the best available resolution.

SCCaptureResolutionNominal.doc: Capture streaming content with a one point to one pixel conversion factor.

SCContentSharingPickerMode.doc: Available modes for selecting streaming content from a picker presented by the operating system.

SCContentSharingPickerModeMultipleApplic.doc: The mode allowing the selection of multiple applications through the presented picker.

SCContentSharingPickerModeMultipleWindow.doc: The mode allowing the selection of multiple windows through the presented picker.

SCContentSharingPickerModeSingleApplicat.doc: The mode allowing the selection of a single application through the presented picker.

SCContentSharingPickerModeSingleDisplay.doc: The mode allowing the selection of a single display through the presented picker.

SCContentSharingPickerModeSingleWindow.doc: The mode allowing the selection of a single window through the presented picker.

SCFrameStatus.doc: Status values for a frame from a stream.

SCFrameStatusBlank.doc: A status that indicates the system didn’t generate a new frame because the display is blank.

SCFrameStatusComplete.doc: A status that indicates the system successfully generated a new frame.

SCFrameStatusIdle.doc: A status that indicates the system didn’t generate a new frame because the display didn’t change.

SCFrameStatusStarted.doc: A status that indicates the frame is the first one sent after the stream starts.

SCFrameStatusStopped.doc: A status that indicates the frame is in a stopped state.

SCFrameStatusSuspended.doc: A status that indicates the system didn’t generate a new frame because you suspended updates.

SCPresenterOverlayAlertSetting.doc: Configures how to present streaming notifications to a streamer of Presenter Overlay.

SCPresenterOverlayAlertSettingAlways.doc: Always display an alert when using Presenter Overlay.

SCPresenterOverlayAlertSettingNever.doc: Never display an alert when using Presenter Overlay.

SCPresenterOverlayAlertSettingSystem.doc: Displays an alert when using Presenter Overlay based on the System Settings.

SCShareableContentStyle.doc: The style of content presented in a stream.

SCShareableContentStyleApplication.doc: The stream is currently presenting one or more applications.

SCShareableContentStyleDisplay.doc: The stream is currently presenting a complete display.

SCShareableContentStyleNone.doc: The stream isn’t currently presenting any content.

SCShareableContentStyleWindow.doc: The stream is currently presenting one or more windows.

SCStreamErrorCode.doc: Codes for user cancellation events and errors that can occur in ScreenCaptureKit.

SCStreamOutputType.doc: Constants that represent output types for a stream frame.

SCStreamOutputTypeAudio.doc: An output type that represents an audio capture sample buffer.

SCStreamOutputTypeScreen.doc: An output type that represents a screen capture sample buffer.

SCStreamType.doc: The display type of the presented stream.

SCStreamTypeDisplay.doc: The stream is currently on a complete display.

SCStreamTypeWindow.doc: The stream is currently presented as a window.

-initWithDesktopIndependentWindow:.doc: Creates a filter that captures only the specified window.

-initWithDisplay:excludingApplications:e.doc: Creates a filter that captures a display, excluding windows of the specified apps.

-initWithDisplay:excludingWindows:.doc: Creates a filter that captures the contents of a display, excluding the specified windows.

-initWithDisplay:includingApplications:e.doc: Creates a filter that captures a display, including only windows of the specified apps.

-initWithDisplay:includingWindows:.doc: Creates a filter that captures only specific windows from a display.

-addObserver:.doc: Adds an observer instance to notify of changes in the content-sharing picker.

-present.doc: Displays the picker with no active selection for capture.

-presentPickerForStream:.doc: Displays the picker with an already running capture stream.

-presentPickerForStream:usingContentStyl.doc: Displays the picker with an existing capture stream, allowing for a single type of capture selection.

-presentPickerUsingContentStyle:.doc: Displays the picker for a single type of capture selection.

-removeObserver:.doc: Removes an observer instance from the content-sharing picker.

-setConfiguration:forStream:.doc: Sets the configuration for the content capture picker for a capture stream, providing allowed selection modes and content excluded from selection.

+captureImageWithFilter:configuration:co.doc: Captures a single frame from a stream as an image, using a filter.

+captureSampleBufferWithFilter:configura.doc: Captures a single frame directly from a stream’s buffer, using a filter.

+getShareableContentExcludingDesktopWind.doc: Retrieves the displays, apps, and windows that match your criteria.
Retrieves the displays, apps, and windows that are in front of the specified window.
Retrieves the displays, apps, and windows that are behind the specified window.

+getShareableContentWithCompletionHandle.doc: Retrieves the displays, apps, and windows that your app can capture.

+infoForFilter:.doc: Retrieves any available sharable content information that matches the provided filter.

-addStreamOutput:type:sampleHandlerQueue.doc: Adds a destination that receives the stream output.

-initWithFilter:configuration:delegate:.doc: Creates a stream with a content filter and configuration.

-removeStreamOutput:type:error:.doc: Removes a destination from receiving stream output.

-startCaptureWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Starts the stream with a callback to indicate whether it successfully starts.

-updateConfiguration:completionHandler:.doc: Updates the stream with a new configuration.

-updateContentFilter:completionHandler:.doc: Updates the stream by applying a new content filter.

contentRect.doc: The size and location of the content to filter, in screen points.

pointPixelScale.doc: The scaling factor used to translate screen points into pixels.

streamType.doc: The type of the streaming content.

style.doc: The display style of the sharable content.

active.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the picker is active.

configuration.doc: Sets the configuration for the content capture picker for all streams, providing allowed selection modes and content excluded from selection.

defaultConfiguration.doc: The default configuration to use for the content capture picker.

maximumStreamCount.doc: The maximum number of streams the content capture picker allows.

setConfiguration(_:for:).doc: Sets the configuration for the content capture picker for a capture stream, providing allowed selection modes and content excluded from selection.

sharedPicker.doc: The system-provided picker UI instance for capturing display and audio content from someone’s Mac.

height.doc: The height of the display in points.

width.doc: The width of the display in points.

applicationName.doc: The display name of the app.

bundleIdentifier.doc: The unique bundle identifier of the app.

processID.doc: The system process identifier of the app.

SCScreenshotDisplayIntent.doc: A value that specifies the type of display a screenshot rendering optimizes for.

SCScreenshotDynamicRange.doc: Specifies the type of images returned to the client; standard dynamic range, high dynamic range, or both.

contentType.doc: A uniform type identifier that specifies the screenshot’s file format; HEIC, JPEG, or PNG.

destinationRect.doc: A rectangle that specifies whether to output screenshots in a subset of the output image.

displayIntent.doc: Specifies whether the screen capture uses attributes of the local or canonical display.

dynamicRange.doc: Specifies the type of image returned to the client; standard dynamic range, high dynamic range, or both.

fileURL.doc: Specifies the URL where the screenshot process saves the output.

height.doc: An integer value that specifies the output height, measured in pixels.

ignoreClipping.doc: A Boolean value that specifies whether to ignore framing on windows when using content filters.

ignoreShadows.doc: A Boolean value that specifies whether to ignore framing on windows.

includeChildWindows.doc: A Boolean that specifies whether the screenshot captures subwindows of the included apps and windows.

showsCursor.doc: A Boolean value that specifies whether the pointer appears in the screenshot.

sourceRect.doc: A rectangle that specifies that the screenshot only samples a subset of the frame input.

supportedContentTypes.doc: An array of uniform type identifiers that correspond to file formats the output image supports.

width.doc: An integer value that specifies the output width in pixels.

fileURL.doc: A URL property that specifies the location of the saved image.

hdrImage.doc: An output property that specifies the high dynamic range version of the screenshot.

sdrImage.doc: An output property that specifies the standard dynamic range version of the screenshot.

contentRect.doc: The size and location of content for the stream.

pointPixelScale.doc: The scaling from points to output pixel resolution for the stream.

style.doc: The current presentation style of the stream.

synchronizationClock.doc: A clock to use for output synchronization.

backgroundColor.doc: A background color for the output.

captureResolution.doc: The resolution at which to capture source content.

capturesAudio.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to capture audio.

capturesShadowsOnly.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the stream only captures shadows.

channelCount.doc: The number of audio channels to capture.

colorMatrix.doc: A color matrix to apply to the output surface.

colorSpaceName.doc: A color space to use for the output buffer.

destinationRect.doc: A rectangle that specifies a destination into which to write the output.

excludesCurrentProcessAudio.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to exclude audio from your app during capture.

ignoreGlobalClipDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the stream ignores content clipped past the edge of a display, when streaming in display style.

ignoreGlobalClipSingleWindow.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the stream ignores content clipped past the edge of a display, when streaming in window style.

ignoreShadowsDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the stream ignores the capturing of window shadows when streaming in display style.

ignoreShadowsSingleWindow.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the stream ignores the capturing of window shadows when streaming in window style.

minimumFrameInterval.doc: The desired minimum time between frame updates, in seconds.

pixelFormat.doc: A pixel format for sample buffers that a stream outputs.

presenterOverlayPrivacyAlertSetting.doc: A value indicating if alerts appear to presenters while using Presenter Overlay.

preservesAspectRatio.doc: A Boolean value that determines if the stream preserves aspect ratio.

queueDepth.doc: The maximum number of frames for the queue to store.

sampleRate.doc: The sample rate for audio capture.

scalesToFit.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to scale the output to fit the configured width and height.

shouldBeOpaque.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if semitransparent content presents as opaque.

showsCursor.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the cursor is visible in the stream.

sourceRect.doc: A rectangle that specifies the source area to capture.

streamName.doc: A name that you provide for identifying the stream.

active.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the window is currently streaming.

frame.doc: A rectangle the represents the frame of the window within a display.

onScreen.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the window is on screen.

owningApplication.doc: The app that owns the window.

title.doc: The string that displays in a window’s title bar.

windowLayer.doc: The layer of the window relative to other windows.
